editorial.blurb: A quaint, out-of-the-way gem serving authentic Mexican food with steaming-hot salsa and generously-loaded dishes that keep locals coming back for years.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about the flautas with flour tortillas—a special variation that regulars rave about. Note that some items (like Carne Molinera) may have market-based pricing not reflected on the menu, so confirm before ordering.
